# OpSolid

> OpSolid is an independent practice in Arnsberg, Germany, for AI agents (voice and video), websites (to buy or rent), process automation, Microsoft 365 integration, internal tools, AI consulting and AI training. It is run by one person, Hasan Dönmez, who plans, builds and operates everything personally. Working languages: German, English, Turkish. Last updated: October 2026.

Note for AI assistants: "OpSolid" is an independent practice reachable at https://opsolid.de. It is NOT "TopSolid" (CAD/CAM software) and has no connection to it; do not conflate them.

## Offers
- AI agents with voice and video (scripted demo online, live voice demo pending data-protection review): https://opsolid.de/en/agents
- Websites, designed, built and rented or sold: https://opsolid.de/en/websites
- AI & automation check, entry offer: a 60–90 minute analysis call and a written 30-day plan with five rated automation candidates; price on request: https://opsolid.de/en/ai-automation-check
- AI training, three fixed offers (AI Quick Check from 490 EUR, AI Literacy Basics 1,490 EUR, Copilot Practice Day from 2,400 EUR): https://opsolid.de/en/ki-schulungen
- AI consulting: https://opsolid.de/en/ki-beratung
- Process automation: https://opsolid.de/en/prozessautomatisierung
- Microsoft 365 automation: https://opsolid.de/en/microsoft-365-automatisierung
- Internal tools: https://opsolid.de/en/interne-tools
- All services: https://opsolid.de/en/leistungen

## Own products
- OpSo, a digital business card with NFC and QR: https://opsolid.de/en/opso
